content:
megan (releases): Heads up — telemetry from the EU canary this morning shows a p99 tail jump after the SDK v2.9 streaming change + runtime 3.2 landing. Can we consider a temporary hold/unpin for the affected model cohort?
deploybot: deploy event: runtime 3.2 promoted to EU-canary at 2026-03-21T02:11Z by @sam
megan (releases): Sam, can you summarise the symptoms? p95 looks fine, p99 +40% and a small uptick in 500s.
sam (eng-runtime): Quick summary: quant-v4b longseq workloads (seq>8k) show KV cache eviction thrash with the new kernel path when combined with SDK streaming keepalive change. p99 up ~40-60ms depending on batch mix, 5xx rate +0.3% on canary hosts.
jia (eng-sdk): SDK streaming change was meant to reduce memory pressure, but we switched to chunked flushing that changes request pacing slightly. It might interact with our continuous batching heuristics. Haven't repro'd locally at scale yet.
pete (eng-sre): I've pulled relevant logs: snippets attached (trimmed):
```
[host-eu-12] 2026-03-21T02:22:10Z request_id=abc123 model=quant-v4b seq_len=10240 kv_hits=0.12 evictions=7 latency=312ms
[host-eu-13] 2026-03-21T02:22:11Z request_id=def456 model=quant-v4b seq_len=2048 kv_hits=0.95 evictions=0 latency=78ms
```
ops-bot: alert: EU-canary runtime-3.2 p99 latency spike threshold breached (30m)
megan (releases): Given this, product wants to avoid customer-visible regressions. Natalie, do we have any high-risk customers in EU on quant-v4b right now?
natalie (product): Two pilot customers with heavy long-context usage in EU. Both are on dedicated capacity (not canary), but routing tests hit canary telemetry. They’d be sensitive. We should be conservative.
sam (eng-runtime): Proposal: soft-hold/unpin runtime 3.2 for quant-v4b in EU region while we investigate. Keep hosted and dedicated unaffected unless we see signals there.
jia (eng-sdk): Alternative: patch SDK streaming toggle to fall back to previous pacing for canary calls; that might be lighter weight than a runtime pin. I can push a scoped toggle to EU canary by noon UTC.
pete (eng-sre): If we unpin, we need a coordinated rollback window: `/deploybot pinback add --component runtime --version 3.1.9 --region eu --models quant-v4b --reason "regression p99 with 3.2" --expires 2026-03-22T08:00Z` — ops will enforce routing. Can we confirm exact command?
megan (releases): That command looks right, Pete. Ops: are there any side effects of adding a pinback for only region+model?
ops-bot: deploybot supports model-scoped pins; will reroute model-matched requests to compatible runtime versions. Policy: pins are advisory for dedicated customers unless enforced by account routing rules.
jia (eng-sdk): I can try the SDK toggle first (less disruption). If it doesn't stabilize within 1 hour, we run the pinback. I'll open a PR to set `streaming_pacing=legacy` for EU canary only.
sam (eng-runtime): OK, but if Jia's toggle doesn't reduce evictions we should unpin quickly. Please include evictions and kv_hit rate in the canary dashboard refresh.
pete (eng-sre): I'll add a temporary alert for evictions>3/min and kv_hit<0.5 on canary hosts. If triggered, we auto-escalate to oncall.
megan (releases): Agreed plan: 1) Jia: deploy SDK EU-canary toggle (target +15m). 2) Pete: watch alerts; if no improvement in 45m, run pinback command and notify customers. 3) Sam: start a diff run to repro offline with longseq inputs. 4) Natalie: prepare customer comms template.
megan (releases): Anyone object to that?
sam (eng-runtime): No objections. I'll prioritize repro run.
jia (eng-sdk): Starting PR now — will post link and deploy logs here.
pete (eng-sre): Created alert and dashboard filter. Watching.
natalie (product): Drafting comms. Will sync with legal + CSM if we pin.
megan (releases): Thanks — tagging @deploybot to standby for pinback execution if needed. :thumbsup:
deploybot: ack — awaiting pinback command.
megan (releases): Follow-up: Jia deployed toggle at 2026-03-21T02:34Z. Early sign: p99 trending down ~10ms after 5min, evictions reduced. Continue to monitor 30m.
pete (eng-sre): 02:45Z update: p99 delta now +10-15ms vs baseline (was +40-60). Evictions down from 7->1 on problematic hosts. Keeping alert on.
megan (releases): Good. Hold off on pinback for now. We'll keep this thread open until 04:00Z for final go/no-go. If numbers regress, we trigger pinback per Pete's command.
megan (releases): Final note for release notes: add line under "Canary regressions" about SDK streaming pacing interacting with runtime kernel paths for quantized long-context models — mitigation applied (SDK toggle) and monitoring.
